title: A Jev Shadow Over Every Expect Step
description: The expect agent already picks a browser action per step from the accessibility tree; this adds a second, typed opinion behind ORK_EXPECT_JEV_SHADOW (default off). One request per enabled step asks a Choice over the bounded legal-action set plus three Nouls (goal reached, page changed as expected, blocked), and the report logs the Jev pick beside the model pick with per-step agreement. The shadow pick is never executed. The page simulates both scenarios live: flag off is a true no-op, flag on shows the picks, probabilities, noul flags, and the JEV_SHADOW report line.
